workflows.R: One original neutral review/revision of exact saved visible S answer; always requested, no best-of choice

analysis.resampling_unit: canonical task family with all A/S/R endpoints together
analysis.interval: pointwise95percent paired percentile bootstrap; no simultaneous coverage claim
analysis.formal_improvement: Exact two-sided paired McNemar with Holm across all4 primary comparisons; direction must be positive
analysis.subtypes: planning diagnostic separately; coding all VERY_HARD, no invented12/12split

cost_convention.experiment: Every physical call charged exactly once; S generated once
cost_convention.standalone_R: S plus R call cost and measured times; missing remainsnull

settings.schedule_order: Accepted200-task bank order; A,S,R consecutively within each task; R follows itsownS withoutoutcomecondition
limitations: Model and domain scope chosen after calibration
Public-source contamination and finite exposure/family exclusions
Coding source passes establish stored-test consistency, not universal truth;95oldercohort+5recent
Fresh bank does not guarantee calibration headroom
One stochastic trajectory per task; no equal-compute control
100tasks/domain provides limited precision; null is not equivalence
Fixed request order is not a randomized service-time experiment; provider alias or latency changes over collection may affect observations

scope: Historical study settings, not a current model availability or pricing claim. No live launchers included.
